title: Katherine Deves among four NSW upper house candidates revealed by One Nation
summary_full: Party’s NSW leader Mike Newman says contenders are ‘people from the real world’ and not ‘career politicians’Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcastThe failed federal Liberal candidate Katherine Deves, who campaigned to exclude transgender women from women’s sport, will stand for One Nation at next year’s New South Wales election.Deves was among four NSW Legislative Council candidates announced by One Nation’s NSW leader, Mike Newman, on Sunday.
